question.nlq: Calculate the average standing points of all drivers in the final five races of each season.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I mean the single average value obtained by aggregating the points of every driver entry across all selected races, resulting in one overall figure for the entire dataset.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH ranked_races AS (
    SELECT 
        raceId,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY round DESC) as rn
    FROM races
),
final_five_races AS (
    SELECT raceId 
    FROM ranked_races 
    WHERE rn <= 5
)
SELECT AVG(ds.points)
FROM driverStandings ds
JOIN final_five_races ffr ON ds.raceId = ffr.raceId

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I mean the average standing points calculated separately for each individual driver based on their performance in those races, returning a list of values per driver.

    FROM driverStandings ds

WITH final_races AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year
    FROM races r
    JOIN (
        SELECT raceId, year, round,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY round DESC) AS rnk
        FROM races
    ) ranked ON r.raceId = ranked.raceId
    WHERE ranked.rnk <= 5
)
SELECT
    s.year AS season,
    d.driverId,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    AVG(ds.points) AS avg_standing_points
FROM final_races fr
JOIN driverStandings ds ON fr.raceId = ds.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN seasons s ON fr.year = s.year
GROUP BY s.year, d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY s.year, d.driverId;
